title: MLP | NATIONS
description: The best Asia-based Geopolitics server! With RPG progression, and immersive gameplay as a nation. Join Now!
body:
⭐ **Welcome to MLP | NATIONS - Geopolitics!** ⭐
_Monarchs of Lost Provinces_

Are you ready to be one of the Monarchs? Or to be the one that follows one. With several immersive features like **economy, skill trees, and claims!** With the center of it all being **ValhallaMMO**. Create your build and wage war against other nations. We're constantly updating the server, adding new content and events every week and day! 

🌏 **Explore the WORLD** 🌏

With a **5k x 5k border**, we have several towns and nations all with their own vast histories. Always ready up with **your friends, or make ones!** Come visit the spawn with /spawn or go around the world, searching for open areas to start anew with /rtp. 

‼️ **Run by Filipino's, made for ALL!** ‼️

We made this as a group of friends, and now we've broadened our horizons, making this server publically open to **EVERYONE!** And that means anyone. Still, follow the rules, and enjoy the server with everyone! Meet you there!

🔗 **Join US!**

👾 **Discord:** https://discord.gg/SQZwPdnp3k

💫 **Server-ip:** mlpnations.endstone.top
